# SoundBus <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SoundBus:Void sound:Int32, bus:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sound` | In | Int32 | required | A sound from [LoadSound](LoadSound) or [Load3DSound](Load3DSound). `0` is ignored. |
| `bus` | In | Int32 | required | A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Picks the bus that the channels of a sound start on, the way [SoundVolume](SoundVolume) picks their volume. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
SoundBus footsteps, world
PlaySound footsteps ; plays on the world bus
```
